name: Codan Limited
summary: Codan Limited engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of communications equipment and solutions, and metal detection equipment. It operates in two segments, Communications and Metal Detection. The Communications segment designs, develops, manufactures, and markets communication equipment, such as DTC and Zetron. The Metal Detection segment designs, develops, manufactures, and markets metal detection equipment, such as handheld metal detecting technologies for recreational, gold mining, demining, and military markets.
